store.description: The candy-feeding puzzle classic, rebuilt for the browser as Cut the Rope: DX with the full level set. Slice ropes, pop bubbles and time your cuts to land the candy in Om Nom's mouth.
features: Full Cut the Rope DX level set with stars to collect
Mouse or touch swipes to cut ropes
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
